description: Hi, I'm Aaradhya. And I'm a 14-year-old intermediate graphic designer with a bit of a hand at coding in Java and Python. I'm an aspiring founder and psychologist—jack of all trades, master of none at its peak.
summary: OUTPOST is an interactive lunar base survival simulator. You run a four-person outpost on the rim of Shackleton Crater near the Moon’s south pole, and your job is to keep the crew alive for 20 days. It opens on a poster-style welcome screen, then a mission briefing, an outpost map, a mission control dashboard, and a log page with sources. It’s built as a web app with TanStack Start and React.
